$comment: Copy Agent Reference (T52 item 4, PEN-69): each case is the input (id: the note’s ULID; gitNotebook: the git notebook’s name, whose local MCP server reads it; notebookId: its notebook.json id, which gives the note its short id; noteIds: the notebook’s other notes, an older one ending as this one does making the short id the whole ULID) and the exact one line every client copies. Written from core’s agentReference by apps/web/test/unit/agent-reference-contract.test.ts; read by the Android app’s contract test.

cases.name: a git notebook’s note: its local MCP server, and its short id
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP (penmoss mcp --notebook "Personal") tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: another notebook id gives another 4 characters
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP (penmoss mcp --notebook "Work") tool read_note {"id":"KFAP-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: the hash covers the whole notebook id
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP (penmoss mcp --notebook "Work") tool read_note {"id":"KVAQ-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: an older note ending the same way: the whole id after the notebook’s 4 characters
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP (penmoss mcp --notebook "Personal") tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-01M6VAE8YFZ99TCZV2SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: a later note ending the same way changes nothing
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP (penmoss mcp --notebook "Personal") tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: double quotes, backslashes and line breaks in the notebook’s name
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP (penmoss mcp --notebook "The \"big\" C:\\ book") tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-00000000"}

cases.name: without a notebook id: the whole id
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP (penmoss mcp --notebook "Personal") tool read_note {"id":"01JBXYZ0000000000000000000"}

cases.name: a note not in a git notebook: no --notebook, and its whole id
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"01JBXYZ0000000000000000000"}
